notes_for_editor: Thin-to-moderate evidence: no primary 1860s source read directly; the Journal of the House of Assembly material comes through Lighthouse Friends (copyrighted; paraphrased). The 1873 'most important' quote appears in the PEI Society page and LF. Tower height: 62 ft (register), 18.8 m (Society), 19.5 m (NOTMAR). Keeper dates from LF; Society list is flagged incomplete. Marine Dept reports in the corpus: hits for 'North Cape' in 1907/1908 annual reports (fog alarm, diaphone) and the 1911-15 improvement lists are Cape North, Nova Scotia, NOT this station; a 1913 wreck-inquiry mention of 'the reef at North Cape' names no vessel and may not be PEI, so omitted. Lens order: Society says fourth-order bull's eye lens; current status unknown. Phee line read from OCR list by position. Heritage register says moved six times; LF/Society document only 1951. Fact-check 2026-10-27: dropped unsourced '1867 on some lists'; moved erosion text under The keepers and 1875 upgrade under Building the light (chapter names per guide); stated Society/LF disagreements on 1873/1874 assessment, mover, tower height, and Guardian Oct 1950 vs 1951 move date. Marine report volume catalogued as 1910 in corpus; Phee line read in one line of OCR, not by column.
